title: Navigating the First Week: UvA Student Experiences & Tips | University of Amsterdam
description:
Join us as second and third-year students share their insights, triumphs, and challenges from the first week back on campus. Plus, discover their advice for making the transition smoother. Remember, it's okay to feel overwhelmed – be kind to yourself and others during this exciting period of change. 

Many challenges and opportunities will come your way during your studies. At the UvA, you can get help and support for your health and well-being. Get more info on UvA services to support your well-being here: https://bit.ly/44G2gRj 

About the series 👇 
In this series you get to know our students and their views on the most relevant and random things in life. Every fortnight a new video!
